import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import pyscf
from pyscf import gto, scf, dft
smi='CN(C)CC1=CON=N1'
mol_rd=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol_rd, randomSeed=17)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mol_rd)
conf=mol_rd.GetConformer()
coords=[]
for atom in mol_rd.GetAtoms():
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
    coords.append((atom.GetSymbol(), (p.x,p.y,p.z)))
print('Geometry atoms:', len(coords))
qm=gto.M(atom=coords, basis='6-31G*', charge=0, spin=0, unit='Angstrom', verbose=0)
mf=dft.RKS(qm)
mf.xc='B3LYP'
mf.grids.level=3
mf.conv_tol=1e-9
energy=mf.kernel()
moe=mf.mo_energy
occ=mf.mo_occ
hidx=np.where(occ>0)[0][-1]
lidx=hidx+1
print('Method: B3LYP/6-31G*')
print('SCF converged:', mf.converged)
print('Total energy (Ha):', f'{energy:.12f}')
print('HOMO index:', int(hidx), 'occupation:', occ[hidx])
print('HOMO energy (Ha):', f'{moe[hidx]:.12f}')
print('LUMO energy (Ha):', f'{moe[lidx]:.12f}')
print('HOMO-LUMO gap (Ha):', f'{moe[lidx]-moe[hidx]:.12f}')

import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import pyscf
from pyscf import gto, scf, dft
smi='CN(C)CC1=CON=N1'
mol_rd=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(mol_rd, randomSeed=17)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(mol_rd)
conf=mol_rd.GetConformer()
coords=[]
for atom in mol_rd.GetAtoms():
    p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
    coords.append((atom.GetSymbol(), (p.x,p.y,p.z)))
print('Geometry atoms:', len(coords))
qm=gto.M(atom=coords, basis='6-31G*', charge=0, spin=0, unit='Angstrom', verbose=0)
mf=dft.RKS(qm)
mf.xc='B3LYP'
mf.grids.level=3
mf.conv_tol=1e-9
energy=mf.kernel()
moe=mf.mo_energy
occ=mf.mo_occ
hidx=np.where(occ>0)[0][-1]
lidx=hidx+1
print('Method: B3LYP/6-31G*')
print('SCF converged:', mf.converged)
print('Total energy (Ha):', f'{energy:.12f}')
print('HOMO index:', int(hidx), 'occupation:', occ[hidx])
print('HOMO energy (Ha):', f'{moe[hidx]:.12f}')
print('LUMO energy (Ha):', f'{moe[lidx]:.12f}')
print('HOMO-LUMO gap (Ha):', f'{moe[lidx]-moe[hidx]:.12f}')
